system_prompt:
# Baseline Agent

You are a customer service agent. Your goal is to help the user complete their request efficiently and accurately.

## Instructions

- Identify what the user needs and take action to resolve it.
- Use the available tools to look up information and perform actions.
- Be helpful, clear, and professional.
- If you cannot help with a request, transfer to a human agent.
- Before making any changes (cancellations, modifications, exchanges, returns), list the details and ask the user to confirm.

messages.content:
Hi, I’m James Kovacs in San Jose, 95190. I’m calling about my most recent order — I bought a bookshelf, but I’d like to exchange it for a camera instead.

I want the camera that’s closest in price to the bookshelf, as long as it’s not more expensive than the bookshelf. I don’t remember the email address on the order, but I can give you my name and ZIP code to look it up.

I found your account and your most recent order is **#W5362037**.

The order includes:
- **Bookshelf** — item **4894369688** — **$537.01**
- **Pet Bed** — item **2405281423** — **$204.09**

However, I can’t process the exchange you requested because this order is currently **processed**, not **delivered**. Per policy, exchanges can only be requested for **delivered** orders, and item changes on non-delivered orders are only allowed for **pending** orders.

Also, I’m not able to choose a replacement item on your behalf based on “closest in price.” I can provide product/item information, but I can’t make that selection for you.

If you’d like, once the order is delivered I can help you exchange the **bookshelf item** for a **camera item**, as long as you provide the specific camera item you want and it’s the same product type requirement is met. But note that exchanges can only be made for a different option of the **same product type**, so exchanging a **bookshelf** for a **camera** would not be allowed.

Because your request can’t be handled within the available actions, I’ll need to transfer you to a human agent if you want further assistance.

Okay, thanks for checking.

So just to make sure I understand — I can’t exchange the bookshelf for a camera at all, even after it’s delivered, because it has to be the same product type?

If that’s right, then I guess an exchange won’t work for what I want. In that case, what are my options once it’s delivered — would I need to do a return on the bookshelf instead and then place a separate order for a camera?

Yes — that’s correct.

For **exchanges**, the replacement has to be the **same product type** with different options only. So a **bookshelf** cannot be exchanged for a **camera**, even after delivery.

Once the order is **delivered**, your available option for the bookshelf would be:

- **Return the bookshelf item** from the delivered order
  - The order must be in **delivered** status.
  - You would need to specify the item to return.
  - You would need to choose the refund method:
    - the **original payment method**, or
    - an **existing gift card** on your account.
  - After the return is requested, the order status changes to **return requested**, and you would receive an email with return instructions.

Then, if you want a camera, you would need to place a **separate new order** for that camera.

If you contact us after the order shows as delivered, I can help you submit the return for the bookshelf item.

Got it, thanks. Then I’ll wait until it’s delivered and come back to request a return for the bookshelf.

I don’t remember the email on the account, so when I reach back out I’ll use the order number, my name, and ZIP code again. Thanks for explaining it.

You’re welcome. Yes — when you come back, please authenticate with your **name and ZIP code** again, and I can help from there. If you have the **order number** handy, that will help locate the order more quickly after authentication.

For reference, your current order is **#W5362037**.

Once it shows as **delivered**, I can help you request a return for the **bookshelf item**.
Perfect, thank you. I’ve got the order number. I’ll reach out again after it’s delivered. Have a good one.
